Overly inclusive and intrusive investigations could hamper investments, innovation, and advancements in these [...] Modern vehicles contain large numbers of chips for engine control, safety systems, infotainment, and electric powertrains. The semiconductor investigation covers imports of semiconductors, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and their derivative products. ## CBT News's Post

### CBT News

April 15, 2025  ·

U.S. Launches Section 232 Investigation into Semiconductor Imports

The U.S. Commerce Department has officially launched a Section 232 investigation into semiconductor imports, a move aimed at evaluating national security risks tied to foreign-sourced chips, manufacturing equipment, and derivative electronics. [...] The products are already subject to a 20% fentanyl tariff, but the reclassification signals a broader strategy to safeguard U.S. technology infrastructure and reduce dependency on foreign—particularly Chinese—manufacturers.

The investigation highlights a growing emphasis on:

• Domestic chip production

• Resilience in the electronics supply chain

• Reinforced national security measures [...] Led by Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, the investigation sets the stage for potential tariffs and tighter controls on semiconductors and related goods. Once published in the Federal Register, a 21-day public comment period will begin.
